name: MAGNETIC STIRRER WITH HOT PLATE
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS Magnetic Stirrer with Hot Plate combines continuous heating and stirring functions into a single robust unit. Ideal for culture media preparation and chemical applications, it features a stainless steel 304 hot plate, thermostatic or digital PID controller, and a precise speed regulator.
features: Combination of magnetic stirrer and hot plate in a single unit
Precise thermostatic or digital temperature controller
Adjustable speed regulator for continuous stirring
Available in 1, 2, and 5 Liters stirring capacities
